license_required.quote: A person may not act as a real estate broker or real estate salesperson, or advertise or assume to act as a real estate broker or real estate salesperson, without a license issued by the real estate commission.

issuing_authority.quote: without a license issued by the real estate commission

name.quote: "Commission" means the North Dakota real estate commission.

type.quote: "Commission" means the North Dakota real estate commission.

age_minimum.quote: an applicant for a broker's or salesperson's license must be at least eighteen years of age.

moral_character_required.quote: Licenses and license renewals may be granted only to persons who bear a good reputation for honesty, truthfulness, and fair dealing and who are competent to transact the business of a real estate broker or a real estate salesperson

degree_required.value: An applicant for a broker's license must have successfully completed an additional sixty hours in courses of study approved by the commission (on top of the ninety hours required for salesperson).
degree_required.quote: An applicant for a salesperson's license shall furnish to the commission evidence the applicant has successfully completed at least ninety hours in courses of study approved by the commission. An applicant for a broker's license must have successfully completed an additional sixty hours in courses of study approved by the commission.

degree_level.quote: An applicant for a broker's license must have successfully completed an additional sixty hours in courses of study approved by the commission.

school_approval_basis.quote: courses of study approved by the commission

credential_pegged.quote: An applicant for a broker's license must have successfully completed an additional sixty hours in courses of study approved by the commission.

required.quote: Every applicant for a license as a real estate broker: a. Must have been actively engaged as a licensed real estate salesperson for a period of at least two years preceding the date of application

experience_source.quote: Must have been actively engaged as a licensed real estate salesperson for a period of at least two years preceding the date of application

duration.quote: actively engaged as a licensed real estate salesperson for a period of at least two years preceding the date of application

kind.quote: actively engaged as a licensed real estate salesperson for a period of at least two years preceding the date of application

exams.name: Real Estate Broker Licensing Examination
exams.notes: Commission prescribes and holds examinations at designated times and places to determine competency. Applicant may take examination before fulfilling prerequisite educational requirement, but license will not be issued until educational requirement is satisfied.
exams.quote: To determine the competency of applicants, the commission shall prescribe and hold examinations at designated times and places.

interval_years.quote: Every person licensed to practice as a real estate broker or real estate salesperson shall register with the commission at a regular interval set by the commission not less than annually and pay the appropriate renewal fee

required.quote: A license may not be renewed by the commission unless the proper certification showing fulfillment of the continuing education requirements of this section and the appropriate licensing fees are submitted to the commission

available.quote: The commission shall recognize the license issued to a real estate broker by another state as satisfactorily qualifying the nonresident broker for license as a broker; provided, the nonresident broker has qualified for license in the broker's own state.

requirements.value: Nonresident broker must be regularly engaged in the real estate business as a vocation, maintain a definite place of business, be licensed in another state, and have qualified for license in the broker's own state. The nonresident applicant must file an irrevocable consent to service of process in North Dakota.
requirements.quote: A nonresident broker regularly engaged in the real estate business as a vocation and who maintains a definite place of business and is licensed in another state may not be required to maintain a place of business within this state. The commission shall recognize the license issued to a real estate broker by another state as satisfactorily qualifying the nonresident broker for license as a broker; provided, the nonresident broker has qualified for license in the broker's own state.

exists.quote: "Commission" means the North Dakota real estate commission.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making a material false statement in the license application or information furnished to the commission.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making a material false statement in the licensee's application for a license or in any information furnished to the commission.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making any substantial and willful misrepresentation in a real estate transaction injurious to any party.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making any substantial and willful misrepresentation with reference to a real estate transaction which is injurious to any party.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making a false promise to influence, persuade, or induce a party to a real estate transaction to that person's injury.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making any false promise of a character such as to influence, persuade, or induce a party to a real estate transaction to that person's injury or damage.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Acting for more than one party in a transaction without the knowledge and consent of all parties.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Acting for more than one party in a transaction without the knowledge and consent of all parties to that transaction for whom the licensee acts.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to account for or remit moneys belonging to others, commingling funds, or failing to keep funds in an escrow or trust account.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to account for or to remit, within a reasonable time, any moneys coming into the licensee's possession belonging to others; commingling funds of others with the licensee's own, failing to keep such funds of others in an escrow or trust account

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being convicted or pleading guilty or nolo contendere to a felony or certain misdemeanors (theft, forgery, embezzlement, etc.).
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being convicted or pleading guilty or nolo contendere before any court of any felony, or of a misdemeanor involving theft, forgery, embezzlement, obtaining money under false pretenses, bribery, larceny, extortion, conspiracy to defraud, or other similar offense.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Claiming or taking any secret or undisclosed amount of compensation or commission, or failing to reveal the full amount of compensation to the principal.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Claiming or taking of any secret or undisclosed amount of compensation or commission or the failure of a licensee to reveal to the licensee's principal or employer the full amount of the licensee's compensation or commission

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing or refusing upon demand to produce any document, book, or record in the licensee's possession concerning a real estate transaction under investigation.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing or refusing upon demand to produce any document, book, or record in the licensee's possession or under that person's control, concerning any real estate transaction under investigation by the commission.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Offering real property for sale or lease without the knowledge and consent of the owner or authorized agent, or on unauthorized terms.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Offering real property for sale or lease without the knowledge and consent of the owner or the owner's authorized agent or on any terms other than those authorized by the owner or agent.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Refusing, because of a protected characteristic, to show, sell, lease, or rent any real estate to prospective buyers or renters.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Refusing, because of race, color, national origin, religion, sex, age, physical or mental disability, or status with respect to marriage or public assistance to show, sell, lease, or rent any real estate to prospective renters, lessees, or purchasers.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing or refusing upon demand to furnish copies of documents pertaining to a real estate transaction to a person whose signature is on the document.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing or refusing upon demand to furnish copies of any document pertaining to any transaction dealing with real estate to any person whose signature is affixed to the document.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Paying compensation or commission in connection with a real estate transaction to any person not licensed as a real estate broker or salesperson.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Paying compensation or commission in connection with any real estate sale, lease, or other transaction to any person that is not licensed as a real estate broker or real estate salesperson under this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to disclose to an owner the licensee's intention or true position when the licensee acquires or intends to acquire an interest in listed property.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to disclose to an owner the licensee's intention or true position if the licensee directly or indirectly through a third party purchases for the licensee or acquires or intends to acquire any interest in or any option to purchase property that has been listed with the licensee's office for sale or lease.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to include a fixed date of expiration in any written listing agreement and failing to leave a copy with the principal.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to include a fixed date of expiration in any written listing agreement and failing to leave a copy of the agreement with the principal.

disciplinary_grounds.description: A broker failing to deliver a complete detailed closing statement to represented parties at the time a transaction is consummated.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A broker failing to deliver to the party or parties represented by the broker a complete detailed closing statement in every real estate transaction, at the time the transaction is consummated

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating any provision of the real estate chapter or any rule or regulation adopted by the commission.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating any provisions of this chapter or rule or regulation adopted by the commission.

disciplinary_grounds.description: A salesperson accepting a commission or valuable consideration from any person other than the licensed broker under whom the salesperson is licensed.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Accepting a commission or valuable consideration as a real estate salesperson for the performance of any of the acts specified in this chapter, or by rule or regulation of the commission, from any person except the licensed real estate broker under whom the individual is licensed as a salesperson.

disciplinary_grounds.description: A broker allowing any unlicensed salesperson to engage in regulated activities carried on under the broker's authority.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: If the licensee is a broker, allowing any unlicensed salesperson to do any act or engage in any activity regulated by this chapter or under rule or regulation of the commission which is carried on in the name of or under the authority of the broker.

disciplinary_grounds.description: A salesperson failing to place trust moneys received with the employing broker within twenty-four hours, or the broker failing to deposit within twenty-four hours of receipt from the salesperson.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A salesperson failing to place with that salesperson's employing broker for deposit in the brokerage trust account all real estate trust moneys received by the salesperson within twenty-four hours of the time of receipt

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to reduce an offer to writing when requested, or failing to submit all offers to a seller until acceptance.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee failing to reduce an offer to writing when a proposed purchaser requests the offer be submitted to the seller, or failure of the licensee to submit all offers to a seller when the offers are received before the seller accepting an offer in writing

disciplinary_grounds.description: Any other conduct constituting dishonesty or fraudulent conduct, whether arising within or without the pursuit of the licensed privilege.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any other conduct, whether of the same or of a different character than specified in this subsection, which constitutes dishonesty or fraudulent conduct, whether arising within or without the pursuit of that person's licensed privilege.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Any conduct not meeting the generally accepted standard of expertise, care, or professional ability expected of real estate brokers or salespersons (disciplinary measure limited to letter of reprimand).
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any conduct that in the determination of the commission does not meet the generally accepted standard of expertise, care, or professional ability expected of real estate brokers or salespersons, provided that any disciplinary measures by the commission under this subdivision must be limited to the issuance of a letter of reprimand to the offending licensee.

insurance_required.quote: The real estate commission shall adopt rules pursuant to chapter 28-32 requiring as a condition of licensure that all real estate salespersons and brokers, except those which hold inactive licenses, carry errors and omissions insurance covering all activities contemplated under this chapter.

definition_quote.value: "Real estate broker", or "broker", means any person that, for another, for a fee, commission, salary, or other consideration, or with the intention or expectation of receiving or collecting such compensation from another, engages in or offers or attempts to engage in, either directly or indirectly by a continuing course of conduct or by a single act or transaction, any of the following acts: [listing, selling, exchanging, purchasing, leasing, negotiating, dealing in options, advertising, assisting or directing in procuring prospects, or publicly marketing equitable interests in purchase contracts].
definition_quote.quote: "Real estate broker", or "broker", means any person that, for another, for a fee, commission, salary, or other consideration, or with the intention or expectation of receiving or collecting such compensation from another, engages in or offers or attempts to engage in, either directly or indirectly by a continuing course of conduct or by a single act or transaction, any of the following acts

license_tiers.quote: "Licensee" means a real estate broker, an associate real estate broker, or a real estate salesperson who is associated with a real estate brokerage firm.

broker_of_record_required.quote: A copartnership, association, corporation, or limited liability company may not be granted a license, unless at least one partner, shareholder, member, manager, or officer of the copartnership, association, corporation, or limited liability company, actually engaged as a real estate broker, holds a license as a real estate broker

pre_exam_experience_years.quote: Must have been actively engaged as a licensed real estate salesperson for a period of at least two years preceding the date of application

pre_exam_instruction_hours.quote: An applicant for a salesperson's license shall furnish to the commission evidence the applicant has successfully completed at least ninety hours in courses of study approved by the commission. An applicant for a broker's license must have successfully completed an additional sixty hours in courses of study approved by the commission.

license_revocation_reapplication_waiting.quote: whose real estate license has not been revoked in this or any other state within two years before the date of application

agency_relationship_types.quote: The agency relationship, which must be established through a written agency agreement, may be a seller agency, a buyer agency, a dual agency, an appointed agency, a subagency, or another form of agency relationship.

dual_agency_written_consent_required.quote: "Dual agency" does not exist unless both the seller and the buyer in a real estate transaction have written agency agreements with the same real estate brokerage firm.

designated_agency_permitted.quote: A real estate brokerage firm, through a designated broker, may appoint in writing to a client the licensee or licensees within the brokerage firm who will act as appointed agent of that client to the exclusion of all other licensees within the brokerage firm.

transaction_licensee_role_permitted.quote: If a different relationship, including a nonagency relationship with a customer, between the real estate brokerage firm and the person for which the real estate brokerage firm performs the services is intended, the relationship must be disclosed in writing pursuant to rules adopted by the board.

written_service_agreement_required.quote: The agency relationship, which must be established through a written agency agreement, may be a seller agency, a buyer agency, a dual agency, an appointed agency, a subagency, or another form of agency relationship.

listing_contract_termination_date_requir.quote: Failing to include a fixed date of expiration in any written listing agreement and failing to leave a copy of the agreement with the principal.

escrow_account_required.quote: every broker, at all times, shall maintain in the broker's name or firm name, a separate, noninterest-bearing trust account designated as such in a federally insured financial institution in this state in which the broker immediately shall place as a demand deposit all funds not the broker's own coming into the broker's possession

commingling_of_funds_prohibited.quote: A broker may not commingle the broker's personal funds or other funds in a trust account, except a broker may deposit and keep a sum not to exceed five hundred dollars in the account from the broker's personal funds

fixed_office_required.quote: Every individual, partnership, association, corporation, or limited liability company licensed as a real estate broker is required to have and maintain a definite place of business within this state, for the transaction of real estate business, except as provided in section 43-23-10.

salesperson_broker_affiliation_required.quote: It is unlawful for any real estate salesperson to perform any of the acts contemplated by this chapter either directly or indirectly after that person's supervision by a broker has been terminated, until the license has been reissued by the commission to a new broker.

qualified_association_permitted.quote: The commission may license an organization of a salesperson, broker, or broker associate if: a. The organization is owned solely by an individual who is licensed as a salesperson, broker, or broker associate

person selling real estate as auctioneer at a bona fide public auction
bank or trust company officers or employees acting in their official capacity

license_exemptions.quote: The term "real estate broker" or "real estate salesperson" does not include: a. Any person, partnership, association, corporation, or limited liability company who is a bona fide owner or lessor... b. An attorney at law... c. Any person selling real estate as an auctioneer... d. Any bank or trust company... e. Any person holding in good faith a duly executed power of attorney... f. Any person while acting as a receiver, trustee, administrator, executor, guardian... g. Public officers while performing their duties.
